## Name & positioning
- Product name: ListClean
- One-line value: ListClean checks a pasted email list and flags invalid, role-based (info@, admin@), and disposable addresses, then gives a deliverability score and a clean list ready to copy.
- Domain: https://emaillistcleaner.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## FAQ
Q1. What is ListClean?
A1. ListClean cleans an email list by flagging invalid, role-based, and disposable addresses, with a deliverability score and a clean list.
Q2. What does it flag?
A2. Invalid syntax, role-based addresses (info@, admin@), and disposable domains.
Q3. Does it give a score?
A3. Yes. It returns a deliverability score for the list.
Q4. Is the clean list ready to use?
A4. It provides a copy-paste-ready clean list of valid addresses.
Q5. Who should use it?
A5. Marketers and founders who mail a list and want to protect sender reputation.
Q6. Why remove role emails?
A6. Role addresses rarely convert and can hurt deliverability; cleaning them improves campaign results.
